data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: awesome-remote-job
data_tooling.summary: Awesome Remote Job 是一个精心整理的 GitHub 资源库，旨在解决远程工作者寻找可靠机会的难题，它汇总了经过筛选的招聘平台、公司和实用工具。其核心采用“awesome-list”格式，这是一个由社区维护的结构化清单，通过用户贡献不断更新，依靠人工审核而非算法来保证质量。你可以用它探索支持远程办公的企业、获取效率工具，或通过添加已验证资源参与共建，使其既是求职者的实用指南，也是一个协作共享的知识库。
data_tooling.summary_en: Awesome Remote Job is a curated GitHub repository that solves the challenge of finding reliable remote work opportunities by aggregating vetted job boards, companies, and resources in one place. Its technical strength lies in the 'awesome-list' format—a community-maintained, structured collection that evolves through contributions, ensuring quality through curation rather than algorithms. You can use it to discover remote-friendly companies, access productivity tools, or contribute by adding verified resources, making it both a practical job-hunting aid and a collaborative knowledge base.

edge_embedded.name: go2rtc
edge_embedded.summary: go2rtc 是一款多功能媒体服务器，旨在解决安防摄像头流在不同协议和设备间兼容的难题。它采用 Go 语言的并发模型，能高效实时转码和转发 RTSP、WebRTC、HLS 等格式流，核心在于轻量级架构避免了传统方案的重编码开销。通过 Docker 部署，可将旧式 RTSP 摄像头无缝接入现代网页或 HomeKit，实现跨平台实时监控，适合智能家居或轻量级监控场景的快速集成实验。
edge_embedded.summary_en: go2rtc is a versatile media server that solves the challenge of streaming security camera feeds across different protocols and devices. Its technical strength lies in using Go's concurrency model to efficiently transcode and relay streams between formats like RTSP, WebRTC, and HLS in real-time. You can deploy it as a Docker container to bridge legacy RTSP cameras with modern web interfaces or HomeKit, enabling seamless monitoring from any browser or mobile app.

deployment_serving.name: go2rtc
deployment_serving.summary: go2rtc 是一款多功能媒体服务器，旨在解决安防摄像头流在不同协议和设备间兼容的难题。它采用 Go 语言的并发模型，能高效实时转码和转发 RTSP、WebRTC、HLS 等格式流，核心在于轻量级架构避免了传统方案的重编码开销。通过 Docker 部署，可将旧式 RTSP 摄像头无缝接入现代网页或 HomeKit，实现跨平台实时监控，适合智能家居或轻量级监控场景的快速集成实验。
deployment_serving.summary_en: go2rtc is a versatile media server that solves the challenge of streaming security camera feeds across different protocols and devices. Its technical strength lies in using Go's concurrency model to efficiently transcode and relay streams between formats like RTSP, WebRTC, and HLS in real-time. You can deploy it as a Docker container to bridge legacy RTSP cameras with modern web interfaces or HomeKit, enabling seamless monitoring from any browser or mobile app.

mlops_monitoring.name: agent-lightning
mlops_monitoring.summary: Agent Lightning 是一个专为提升AI智能体性能而设计的训练框架，旨在解决智能体在复杂任务中表现不稳定的问题。它通过强化学习技术，让智能体在模拟环境中反复试错并优化决策策略，从而学会更可靠地执行任务。开发者可以利用该框架训练定制化智能体，例如用于自动化客服或游戏对战场景，框架提供的监控工具还能帮助实时调整训练过程，让智能体在实践中不断进化。
mlops_monitoring.summary_en: Agent Lightning is a training framework that helps developers create more capable and reliable AI agents by addressing the challenge of inconsistent performance in complex tasks. It employs reinforcement learning techniques to systematically improve agent decision-making through iterative feedback loops, teaching agents to learn from their mistakes. Developers can use it to train custom agents for applications like automated customer support or game-playing bots, with the framework providing tools to monitor progress and refine behaviors.
